name: The Atelier of Love
source:
Welcome to the atelier of love, where you will follow Lovelia's great adventure as she solves the love, friendship, and relationship problems of all these crazy clients. But that's not all—you will also have to repair the objects that are so dear to them.

[From [url=https://tsukiyorokashi.itch.io/the-atelier-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到爱情工作室，在这里你将跟随洛芙莉亚的伟大冒险，她会解决所有这些疯狂客户的爱情、友谊和关系问题。但这还不是全部——你还必须修复他们如此珍视的物品。

[来自[url=https://tsukiyorokashi.itch.io/the-atelier-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
